what: leading-zero count and normaliser, four variants (arith library, brief 139b)
rtl_source: origin/b139b-arith-previvado at dfb4a29cf9 (PR 263; not on main)

bench.description: the function's exhaustive stream bench (Icarus, every input of each width, 25% idle gaps, latency and order checked) at every variant at widths 3 to 12 (pipeline depth as the library's exhaustive test chooses it), 40 configurations

timeout_policy: A bench run that exceeds its time limit is `timed_out`: it is not counted as killed and not as a survivor; it is listed, and the worst-case score counts it as a survivor. A formal run that exceeds its limit is `undecided`, handled the same way. Neither is ever counted as a kill.

filter.method: miter: BMC, then register-matched induction (yosys equiv_induct), then an unbounded proof (sby)
filter.compared: in_ready always; out_valid always; out_data when out_valid is high (the stream interface's contract)
filter.start_state: registers without an initial value start at 0 in both versions
